Name: Sebastian Smokes Weed
Author: Fuzzlepuzzle
Description:
[size=4][b]Description:
[/b][/size]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1643/]Non-Smoking Sebastian[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4768]Content Filter[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2485]Sebastian's Bong[/url], this is a small Content Patcher mod which replaces Sebastian's nicotine habit with a much less harmful marijuana habit. This is intended to be a more adult alternative to NSS and CF, both of which give him a gaming addiction instead.

This mod consists of small dialogue and visual changes; a config is included so you may toggle off either half if you prefer not to use it.

If you have suggestions on making anything sound more natural or flow better, I'm all ears. :) I've never used marijuana so I've got basically no idea what I'm doing. I also didn't actually test any of the dialogue, except for the 10-heart event.

This mod works in 1.6 without needing any updates. It's a simple mod, so it should theoretically work with all future updates unless they radically change how dialogue or sprites are loaded. (Which seems unlikely.)


[size=4][b]Features:
[/b][/size]The dialogue portion of this mod changes one optional line from the farmer in an event, two lines from Sebastian, and two lines from Robin. It also adds two new lines of dialogue which modify lines from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]. (CFDE is not required to see these new lines.) Like his nicotine addiction, Sebastian's overuse and abuse of weed isn't viewed favorably by those who comment on it, including Sebastian.

The visual portion of this mod replaces the cigarette in his overworld sprite with a green bong which he lights and then takes a drag from.


If you'd like to read exactly what the lines are, they can be found below.

[spoiler](during the 10-heart event, Sebastian takes a drag before asking about the view:)
[b]Sebastian:[/b] So, what do you think?
[b]Farmer:[/b] [CHOICE] You smoke that too often.
[b]Sebastian:[/b] Ugh... You sound like my mom.
[b]Sebastian:[/b] ...*sigh*
[b]Sebastian:[/b] You're right, though. I use it to run away from my problems. It's not a solution.

[b]Sebastian (married):[/b] I realized I've stopped smoking as much since we got married... I'm not so stressed out anymore. I don't need it to take my mind off things.
[b]Sebastian:[/b] It's nice not having to get high just to get through the day.

[b]Sebastian (unhappily married):[/b] I've started getting stoned every day again... I've just been really stressed out lately.

[b]Sebastian (married, the day after a festival in fall):[/b] Abigail and I smoked some weed together at the fair yesterday. It was nice spending time with her.

[b]Robin:[/b] Sebastian's been smoking a lot. Should I be worried?
[b]Robin:[/b] Sometimes I worry about Sebastian... he doesn't have many friends and doesn't really seem to care about his future very much...
[b]Robin:[/b] I would talk to him about it but he never opens up to me.

[b]Robin:[/b] Ugh, I wish Sebastian wouldn't smoke.
[b]Robin:[/b] At least it's better than cigarettes... I guess.

[b]Robin (in-law):[/b] Sebastian seems so much happier now! I'm really proud of him.[/spoiler]

[b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Tested compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/722]Gender Neutrality Mod[/url]﻿. I haven't re-tested them since 1.6, but I expect them to still work.
[*]There's one line in a (Mature Content) event in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ that says Sebastian's smoking is "unhealthy", which is kind of weird in the context of this mod, but they were otherwise compatible as of December 2020. I don't think SVE has added any additional immersion-breaking dialogue since, but I haven't checked.
[*]Might not be fully compatible with mods that change Sebastian's dialogue. This will just cause some inconsistencies if the other mod adds dialogue which mentions him smoking, so it's not a big deal.
[*]The visual half of the mod is incompatible with other mods that change Sebastian's overworld sprite. You may toggle off "Sprite Changes" and headcanon that he's smoking a joint instead. :)
[*]This mod is written in English. It might break the mod if you're playing SDV in a different language.
[/list]

[b][size=4]Suggested Mods:
[/size][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2485]Sebastian's Bong[/url]﻿ replaces the vase in Seb's room with a color-configurable bong.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url] adds a bunch of new dialogue to all the vanilla characters, and inspired a couple lines in this mod.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] allows you to change config files in-game.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4768]Content Filter[/url] includes a non-smoking Willy, if you'd like to completely remove tobacco from your game.


[size=4][b]Install:
[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game.
[*]If you wish, go into the mod folder and change the config.json file. You may also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]this mod[/url]﻿ to configure mods in-game.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Future Updates?
[/b][/size]New, extra dialogue talking about Sebastian's smoking.
A Slightly Cuter version of Seb's overworld sprite.
Maybe a configurable color for the bong, if someone asks for it.
The will to make mods. :)

[size=1](I don't think I've hit all of the keywords for description searches yet, so let me repeat that this is a mod where Seb is a stoner who smokes cannabis.)[/size]
